svg.title: All 130 of yah265's VBR rungs come within 10% of their target
svg.desc: Dot plot of VBR rate error per rung for every real-title cell, yah265 and x265.
svg.text: All 130 of yah265's VBR rungs come within 10% of their target
Achieved bitrate against the target over the whole cell, five rungs per encoder. The shaded band is the ±10% bar, which applies to yah265.
achieved bitrate against the target (left is under)
